title: The Voyage Home
author: Barış Kısır
premise: London, 1944. Railway clerk Nell Whitfield keeps the departures board at Paddington — every train, every soldier, every goodbye. When her brother's name appears on a casualty list and then a letter arrives from a soldier she never met claiming to be him, Nell must decide whether the man coming home is her brother, an impostor, or the war's strangest mercy.
